description: Microsoft said it planned to spend about $80 billion building AI-enabled data centers in fiscal 2025, with more than half in the United States.

Amazon is expanding AI infrastructure and agent products (including Trainium chips and Bedrock) and holds a large stake in Anthropic. It did not disclose a single figure tied to the 2025 corporate restructuring.
Meta cited an AI infrastructure investment of roughly $115–135 billion in 2026 (midpoint recorded here) as it reallocated staff and capital toward AI.
Oracle is expanding Oracle Cloud Infrastructure and AI data centers; some AI teams grew even as overall headcount fell. It did not disclose a single figure tied to the fiscal 2026 reductions.
